summary: feat(settings): record passkey alert and banner views in Glean
description:
Because:

* Settings did not record when it showed a passkey alert or banner.
* CI failed: GleanMetricsT had no alertBar or banner group.

This commit:

* Adds the alert_bar.view and banner.view Glean events and wiring.
* Records AlertBar and Banner views when the caller gives a gleanId.
* Tags the passkey alerts, Learn more links, close button and row CTA.
* Sets a gleanId on the passkey sign-in banner builders.

Closes FXA-13972
